messages:
maria: Heads-up — we're trying to formalize onboarding stages for design partners so feedback hits SLAs and routing is predictable. Idea: 3-stage onboarding (intro, pilot run, scale/rollout) with clear feedback gates. Thoughts?

sachin: +1 on stages. Can we make the gates binary-ish? pass/fail on a small set of metrics so eng/product know when to act.

ellie: love binary gates. propose metrics: weekly response rate >= 70%, NPS / qualitative sentiment >= 3/5 on pilot prompts, and 3 reproducible bug reports or fewer per week.

liam: operational note — eng needs clear ownership for routing: triage -> bug -> hotfix or backlog. Who's owning triage during pilot?

olivia: CS will own first 2 weeks of triage, then hand off to SRE/eng for persistent issues. We'll staff 2 CSMs for each cohort.

maria: good. let's put SLA targets: CSM ack within 4h, engineering triage decision within 24h for sev >= P2, fix ETA or backlog placement within 72h. add these to playbook?

jen: add incentive/compensation notes — partners in pilot get $X credit + public early access badge, helps retention and response rates. also a one-off 1:1 post-pilot debrief required.

sachin: routing rules idea: all functional regressions tagged #regression go to eng immediately; UX/UX-smell to product; infra/perf to eng-infra. We'll put a Zapier webhook to create tickets with tags from the feedback form.

ellie: feedback format: require short reproduction steps + a sample prompt + expected vs actual. We'll share a lightweight template. If partners can't reproduce, treat as observation not regression.

maria: draft checklist for stage transitions (shareable):
```
Stage 0 (Intro): partner signed LOA, access keys provisioned, kickoff call done
Stage 1 (Pilot run): 1-week smoke + 2-week pilot, weekly checkins, feedback form submitted at least weekly
Gate -> Pass if weekly response rate >=70% and no critical regressions
Stage 2 (Scale): production-like traffic, perf metrics monitored, SLA targets agreed
Gate -> Pass if latency & cost targets met plus quality hold
```

liam: can we add quantitative quality hold? e.g., 95th-percentile BLEU-like QoR or a prompt-eval pass rate. We should avoid brand names — call it "prompt pass rate" >= 85% on curated eval set.

olivia: onboarding cadence proposal: week 0 kickoff, week 1 smoke + template check, week 2 pilot start, week 4 pilot review & decision. Send calendar invites immediately after enrolment.

maria: ok good. next: escalation flow. if partner misses two weekly feedback check-ins, CSM flags dropout risk and offers 1:1. If unresponsive for 10 days, mark as dormant and pause credits.

sachin: also propose a small automation: onboarding-bot posts a weekly nudge in partner channel and pins outstanding items. we can reuse the internal "onboarding-bot" for that.

ellie: UX request: create a partner-facing one-page "what we need from you" with timeline and suggested sample prompts. keeps expectations aligned.

maria: action items: 1) sachin to draft gate metric definitions + webhook routing (due in 3 days). 2) ellie to make feedback template + 1-pager (due 5 days). 3) olivia to draft staffing rota for CSMs (due 4 days). 4) liam to draft triage runbook and ticket tags (due 5 days). 5) jen to draft incentive language for LOA (due 3 days).

sachin: I'll also sketch the minimal payload for the webhook: partner_id, severity, prompt, reproduction, tag(s). will post sample JSON in this thread.

maria: perfect. once those are in place we'll run a dry-run with internal volunteers and measure response rates. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
